notes.title: VR Austria update available
notes.notes:
The recently announced update of VR Austria was published today!
With respect to your reviews and suggestions, the update is packed with bug fixes plus new features like a map for navagation and HTC Vive controller support.

Like the new version of VR Austria?
We would appreciate a short [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/779810/VR_Austria/]recommendation at our store page[/url]!

If you have suggestions for future releases, make sure to tell us those as well!
